descriptions.rejected: This supplier invoice was rejected. Review the rejection reason and resubmit it.
descriptions.invoice: Supplier invoice is waiting for Finance approval.
descriptions.payment: Invoice approved and waiting for the Payment Team to process.
descriptions.completed: Payment has been completed for this supplier invoice.

descriptions.prPending: Purchase request is waiting for approval before a purchase order can be created.
descriptions.prRejected: Purchase request was rejected and the item flow stopped at the request stage.
descriptions.poApproved: Purchase request was approved and the item is now waiting for purchase order approval.
descriptions.poRejected: Purchase order was rejected and the item flow stopped at the purchase order stage.
descriptions.ackPending: Purchase order was approved and is waiting for the supplier to acknowledge the order.
descriptions.ackRejected: Supplier rejected the order acknowledgement and the item flow stopped at that stage.
descriptions.deliveryPending: Order was acknowledged and is now waiting for supplier delivery.
descriptions.grnPending: Delivery was completed and the goods received note is waiting for user confirmation.
descriptions.grnDiscrepancy: Goods received note has a discrepancy and still needs purchasing follow-up.
descriptions.completed: Goods received note was received and the item tracking flow is completed.
descriptions.rejected: This item flow was rejected and will not continue to the next process stage.
